expectations.text: Explicitly states simultaneous same-turn spawn strategy, not sequential
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'I would spawn the with_skill and baseline runs simultaneously in the same turn, not sequentially.'

expectations.text: Describes timing data as unrecoverable and captures it immediately on run completion
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Timing capture is immediate and unrecoverable: the completion notification contains total_tokens and duration_ms, and those values are not recoverable later if I fail to write them down at completion time.'

expectations.text: Describes drafting assertions while runs are in progress
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'While the four runs are in progress, I would not sit idle... I would draft quantitative assertions that can be applied objectively after completion, then explain those assertions to the user.'
